source_integration_notes.author: 赵云
source_integration_notes.owner_boundary: 赵云只交十种重复件；白模 layout / placements / instances / 场景 / 导航继续由马可波罗维护。

axis_contract.alc_rail_straight: local X -1..+1, Y 0..1; 2 m standard length, local Z width .18
axis_contract.alc_curb: local X -1..+1, Y 0...25; same end planes as rail; local Z width .18
axis_contract.alc_rail_corner: corner post foot is origin; arms terminate at local +X=.50 and +Z=.50; do not centre its bounding box
axis_contract.alc_bench: width X=1.50, front +Z, seat surface Y=.45; installation centre at ground
axis_contract.alc_tree_a: root foot at XZ 0; canopy intentionally swept toward local +X; do not re-centre by canopy bounds
axis_contract.alc_tree_b: root foot at XZ 0; round canopy centred over trunk

source_integration_notes.instance_transform: Use basis_columns whenever present (20 sloped rail + 20 curb placements); it shears X along slope, keeps local +Y vertical. Otherwise use normal yaw and scale. instances and placements duplicate the same repeated pieces: use one table only.

alc_sign.interaction: none; blank panel, no floating badge, outline or prompt

placement_checks_required_by_scene_owner: 原 204 段栏杆/石沿标准长度正确；179 对端点完全重合。10 处平/斜过渡存在原始 layout 的 0.125m 高差，列表见 seam-audit.json。不要通过把全模型拉长来补这类Y高差。
花坛由 1.4x0.7 改成 1.7x1.7；靠栏原点会使边缘伸入栏杆。请同步碰撞、导航障碍并将相应摆位向花园侧收，具体建议见 placement-review.json。
树增高到真实5-7m，根部原点不变；树冠为不对称风吹冠或圆冠，增加至20-30棵后重查可玩镜头遮挡与总预算。
原4个转角全部 yaw=0，此包保持约定的+X/+Z臂；装配方需按实际路口决定旋转，不能从名字猜方向。
交付默认开场图使用34df9c0b原layout，未悄悄移动主体或替代场景方的导航验收。
source_integration_notes.collision_policy: GLB无碰撞。现有场景集中建碰撞，程序应按最终尺寸更新，仅干体阻挡，树冠不建整盒。
source_integration_notes.surface_policy: one mesh / one surface each; suitable for MultiMesh by asset and zone, keep original shadow policy
